findings.highlight: scarfing down the galbi like there's no tomorrow
findings.evidenceJa: わんこ蕎麦を食すが如きに霜降りカルビを食べる
findings.governingReading: Shirou imagines himself nibbling shiokara while Rin repeatedly consumes marbled kalbi as though it were endless little servings of soba.
findings.explanation: The barbecue fantasy loses its wanko-soba comparison and concrete food contrast.

findings.highlight: As soon as she sees me
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は俺たちを見るなり
findings.governingReading: 俺たち refers to the pair; the next dialogue explicitly addresses their being together.
findings.explanation: Sakura reacting to seeing Shirou and Rin together becomes reacting to Shirou alone.

findings.highlight: What the hell am I saying!?
findings.evidenceJa: なにを聞いてたんだ俺はっ
findings.governingReading: The recalled invitation makes him ask what he had been listening to: he failed to register Sakura’s earlier request.
findings.explanation: Shirou reproaches his failure to listen as a failure in what he is saying.

findings.highlight: I'm already happy enough right now.
findings.evidenceJa: わたし、いまので十分嬉しかったです
findings.governingReading: いまので identifies what Shirou just did as sufficient to delight her despite the missed meal.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s happiness caused by his attempted gesture becomes a description of her present mood.
